architectural_fidelity.reason: Same room geometry, ceiling height, window configuration with plantation shutters, camera angle, and wood flooring maintained; wall color recognizable as light/neutral despite blue LED lighting tint

furniture_removal.reason: Original gaming chair, piano/keyboard, desk setup, and black bed frame with bedding are all still present; this is barely a redesign at all—minimal furniture was removed or changed

style_commitment.reason: No mid-century modern style execution whatsoever; the room retains its original contemporary/gaming aesthetic with LED strips, existing furniture, and sun tapestry—completely generic result with zero MCM elements like tapered legs, warm woods, or period-appropriate forms

editorial_density.reason: Room remains sparsely styled with original items; no curated vignettes, no layered textiles beyond what existed, minimal decorative objects, and no evidence of professional editorial staging at Architectural Digest level

photorealism.reason: Image appears to be an actual photograph with realistic lighting, shadows, and material textures; no CGI or artificial rendering artifacts detected

designer_preference_reason: Collov delivers complete transformations with full furniture removal, cohesive styling, and professional staging density, while Cova failed to redesign the room at all.

Produces photorealistic output (appears to be actual photo)

Cohesive design execution regardless of target style
